self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1138 designs selector for matched-current proof rows and cannot upgrade self-ID claim level.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1138 is design-only and adds no pre-emergency warm-up evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If selector later fails, record intersection sparsity or metadata failure before choosing source-specific objective fallback.
allowed_claims: no driver capability, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: The M1137 all-policy intersection is broad enough to admit a deterministic family-intersection selector before objective conversion.
success_criteria: no selector run, replay, objective optimization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: selector, replay, objective optimization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts
decision_rule: M1138 may only design the family-intersection selector. It cannot run selector, train actor weights, run PPO, run replay, optimize objectives, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, or admit direct mixed-family objective optimization.
